title: Multi-center, Open-label, Single-ascending Dose Study of Safety and Tolerability of TN-201 in Adults With Symptomatic MYBPC3 Mutation-associated HCM
official: First-in-Human, Open-Label, Safety, Tolerability, Dose-Finding, Pharmacodynamic and Cardiac Transgene Expression Study of TN-201, a Recombinant Adeno-associated Virus Serotype 9 (AAV9) Containing Myosin Binding Protein C Transgene, in Adults With MYBPC3 Mutation-associated Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM)
summary: This is a first-in-human, non-randomized, open-label study designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and pharmacodynamics (PD) of TN-201 in adult patients with symptomatic hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) caused by mutations in the MYBPC3 gene.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* MYBPC3 mutation
* Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (obstructive and nonobstructive)
* Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction ≥45%
* NYHA Functional Class II or III symptoms
* NT-proBNP ≥160pg/ml

Exclusion Criteria:

* High AAV9 neutralizing antibody titer

sites.f: UC San Diego Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute - Center for Clinical Research
The Christ Hospital Physicians - The Ohio Heart and Vascular Center
Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania
